test.create_query: CREATE TABLE skm ( CounterID UInt32, EventDate Date, EventTime DateTime, UserID UInt64, RegionID UInt32, ResolutionWidth UInt16, INDEX i_time EventTime TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1, INDEX i_user UserID TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1, INDEX i_region RegionID TYPE set(0) GRANULARITY 1 ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(UserID) % 8 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime) SETTINGS index_granularity = 1024, old_parts_lifetime = 10, add_minmax_index_for_numeric_columns = 0, add_minmax_index_for_temporal_columns = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO skm SELECT CounterID, EventDate, EventTime, UserID, RegionID, ResolutionWidth FROM hits_100m_single SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 16, max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0
OPTIMIZE TABLE skm FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1, optimize_skip_merged_partitions = 1
ALTER TABLE skm CLEAR INDEX i_time, MATERIALIZE INDEX i_time, CLEAR INDEX i_user, MATERIALIZE INDEX i_user SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
ALTER TABLE skm CLEAR INDEX i_region, MATERIALIZE INDEX i_region SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(rows), sum(marks)) != (8, 100000000, 97669)) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'skm' AND active
SELECT throwIf(count() != 3 OR min(data_compressed_bytes) = 0) FROM system.data_skipping_indices WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'skm'

SELECT throwIf(( countIf(EventTime BETWEEN toDateTime('2013-07-03 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND toDateTime('2013-07-30 23:59:59', 'UTC')), sumIf(ResolutionWidth, EventTime BETWEEN toDateTime('2013-07-03 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND toDateTime('2013-07-30 23:59:59', 'UTC')), countIf(UserID BETWEEN 4611686018427387904 AND 4612686018427387904) + countIf(UserID BETWEEN 9223372036854775808 AND 9224372036854775808), sumIf(ResolutionWidth, UserID BETWEEN 4611686018427387904 AND 4612686018427387904) + sumIf(ResolutionWidth, UserID BETWEEN 9223372036854775808 AND 9224372036854775808), countIf(RegionID IN ({rare1}, {rare2}, {rare3}, {rare4})), sumIf(ResolutionWidth, RegionID IN ({rare1}, {rare2}, {rare3}, {rare4})), countIf(RegionID IN (20, 23, 26, 35, 37, 47, 60, 66)), countIf(RegionID IN (230, 202)), sumIf(ResolutionWidth, RegionID IN (230, 202)) ) != (92747387, 120539295295, 5108, 6385568, 11829, 15118689, 0, 22558375, 28229547375)) FROM skm SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = 0

SELECT throwIf(( countIf(tmax >= toDateTime('2013-07-03 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND tmin <= toDateTime('2013-07-09 23:59:59', 'UTC')) + countIf(tmax >= toDateTime('2013-07-10 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND tmin <= toDateTime('2013-07-16 23:59:59', 'UTC')) + countIf(tmax >= toDateTime('2013-07-17 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND tmin <= toDateTime('2013-07-23 23:59:59', 'UTC')) + countIf(tmax >= toDateTime('2013-07-24 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND tmin <= toDateTime('2013-07-30 23:59:59', 'UTC')), countIf(umin <= 4612686018427387904 AND umax >= 4611686018427387904) + countIf(umin <= 9224372036854775808 AND umax >= 9223372036854775808), sum(rare), countIf(absent), countIf(top1) + countIf(top2) ) != (122709, 189637, 2926, 0, 185481)) FROM ( SELECT min(EventTime) AS tmin, max(EventTime) AS tmax, min(UserID) AS umin, max(UserID) AS umax, max(RegionID IN ({rare1})) + max(RegionID IN ({rare2})) + max(RegionID IN ({rare3})) + max(RegionID IN ({rare4})) AS rare, max(RegionID IN (20, 23, 26, 35, 37, 47, 60, 66)) AS absent, max(RegionID = 230) AS top1, max(RegionID = 202) AS top2 FROM skm GROUP BY _part, intDiv(_part_offset, 1024) ) SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = 0
SELECT throwIf((sum(`count()`), sum(`sum(ResolutionWidth)`)) != (92747387, 120539295295)) FROM ({weeks}) SETTINGS force_data_skipping_indices = 'i_time', log_comment = 'skip_index_minmax_set_hits.q1'
